每小时的分数取前后三小时平均；当天出钓指数 = 最好 6 个小时的平均占六成，全: Each hour's score is averaged with its neighbours; the day's bite index is 60% the average of its best 6 hours and 40% the average of the whole day, so it reflects both how good the best hours are and how the day holds up overall.
有雷暴、大风或大浪的日子，出钓指数最多给 60 分；雷暴或大浪持续 3 小时以上: Days with thunderstorms, strong gusts or high waves are capped at 60; three or more hours of storms or high waves cap the day at 45.
